name: temporal-reachability-generalization-v1
hypothesis: A temporal obstacle track and reachable passing corridor increase completed laps across unseen official-generator geometries while avoiding new crashes and aggregate contact or damage increases against the current active bare Agent route.
evidence_scope: Fresh paired local official-generator evaluation. The ten reused feasible-corridor diagnostic cells may be used for debugging only; none counts toward screening, confirmation, blind, or promotion.

source_construction.rule: Copy the normalized committed Git blob of agent.py to the control snapshot. Replace exactly one selector_from byte sequence with selector_to for the candidate snapshot; no other source byte may differ. Pin the commit, blob, both snapshot hashes, model and runtime helpers before any fresh episode. The live Agent selector remains the control route until promotion.

seed_derivation: For each partition and zero-based index i, use the first four SHA256 bytes of UTF-8 'temporal-reachability-generalization-v1:<partition>:<i>' as an unsigned big-endian 32-bit integer. All 32 geometry seeds are distinct and absent from the conservative historical seed set in experiments/*.json before this draft was written. Reserve a seed across every track ID.
evaluation_budget: Screen 8, confirmation 16, blind 8 independent geometry seeds, each crossed with track IDs 1-4: 32/64/32 canonical paired cells and 256 cold-process canonical episodes. Two/four/two repeated cells across both arms add 16 cold deterministic-reload episodes, 272 maximum. Repeats never increase the independent geometry count.
decision_rule: At each partition, require every canonical pair and every repeat with matching deterministic reload, no lost control finish, no new candidate crash, no both-DNF progress loss over 0.05, total candidate contacts and damage no greater than control, total time on shared completed laps no more than 5 percent slower, and each shared completed lap no more than 10 percent slower. An operational, source, environment, runtime or receipt failure rejects. With safety gates satisfied, rank by more finishes; tied finishes by mean progress improvement over 1e-9; tied finishes and progress by lower total time on shared completed laps. Report every pair and all regressions. Screen RETAIN and a sealed finalist are required before confirmation; confirmation RETAIN and an accepted seal are required before blind. The source remains fixed after screening and blind may not select a replacement candidate.
promotion_gate: Only blind RETAIN after screen and confirmation RETAIN supports activating this frozen candidate. Even a passing blind is finite-sample local-generator evidence and does not certify every possible track or the official Linux CPU container.
limits: The four track IDs share a seed's geometry and vary obstacles. Independent geometry counts are 8/16/8, not 32/64/32. Earlier confirmation/blind reservations remain sealed and are never recycled. This draft cannot run until the candidate source, route class, and hashes are frozen.
